name: Jack Tisdale
role: Northern Pacific employee; later at the Elkhorn ranch
bio: Jack Tisdale worked for the Northern Pacific and married in May 1886, when he and his wife were welcomed at Medora. By December 1886 they were keeping house at the Elkhorn ranch, and warrants were issued for his arrest as an accessory in the case against George Myers.
